content.text: Section 22 is the only audit-rights clause; § 23 (Records and Customer Assurance) is a bare heading with no operative text, and no other verification/inspection right binds Customer.

input.quote: 22.1 Vendor may audit Customer's compliance with licence quantities no more than once in any twelve-month period, on at least thirty days' prior written notice, during normal business hours, and in a manner that does not unreasonably disrupt Customer. An audit will be conducted off-site where practicable by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality.
input.rationale: Section 22 is the only audit right binding us (§ 23 is a heading with no operative text, and no other inspection, verification, metering or remote-monitoring right exists). It meets the preferred position in full: audits are limited to once in any twelve-month period on at least thirty days' prior written notice, during normal business hours, off-site where practicable, and by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality (§ 22.1); Vendor bears audit costs unless the audit establishes an underpayment exceeding five percent, and Vendor and its auditor may not access Customer systems directly (§ 22.2). Section 22.3 additionally makes findings our Confidential Information. No redline required.
